name: medfriend-mcp-servers
description: Integrity-pinned MCP server(s) that MedFriend launches over stdio. Installed with `npm ci` from the committed lockfile so npx cannot pull an unpinned/tampered release. The `overrides` block forces @modelcontextprotocol/sdk forward from the vulnerable 1.0.1 that the archived server-google-maps@0.6.2 pins, patching GHSA-8r9q-7v3j-jr4g (ReDoS), GHSA-w48q-cv73-mx4w (DNS rebinding), and the cross-client data-leak advisory. It also pins the sdk's own hono/@hono/node-server transitives forward, clearing CVE-2026-69207, CVE-2026-71848/71849/71850 and GHSA-frvp-7c67-39w9; those are the sdk's HTTP transport, which MedFriend does not use (it launches the server over stdio), but an unexploitable CVE is still a CVE on the dependency graph.
